result.title: Auditing Multi-Proxy Explanations of Web User Preferences: Identification Boundaries and Abstention
result.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at WSDM 2027 (Main Track)
result.summary: Web systems infer user preferences from behavior, ratings, text, and LLM-generated profiles, yet explaining a proxy may reveal its measurement process rather than the preference of interest. We develop an audit framework distinguishing point identification, partial identification, and abstention relative to an explicit reference distribution. Under feature-dependent, arbitrarily signed proxy bias, a strict majority of uncontaminated proxy attributions lets the coordinatewise median recover latent-attribution support and direction and, with externally justified positive scales, magnitude. We prove this threshold sharp using response-valid indistinguishable worlds, characterize sharp minimax error and exact compatible-target sets under approximate cleanliness and scale uncertainty, and propagate clean-proxy attribution error. A frozen known-truth benchmark spans two response families, four proxy counts, all contamination counts, three bias strengths, and eleven methods, with a focal comparison confirmed on twenty unseen seeds. Under correct budgets, a direct attribution-tensor audit achieved 100% coverage, 95.40%-97.05% active-driver sign decisions, and no false signs. In a temporally separated Amazon study, median aggregation reduced comparator-relative conditional sign error for all four targets; six of eight prespecified target-metric contrasts had Bonferroni intervals excluding zero. A controlled real-covariate perturbation favored the median on the prespecified focal metric for all four targets. Compatible sets showed that the current proxy configuration rarely licensed strict-sign conclusions. Weak comparator calibration limits the Amazon evidence to fitted-surface alignment rather than latent-preference recovery.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出一个审计框架，区分点识别、部分识别与弃权，证明在代理偏差方向任意但多数代理未被污染时，坐标中位数可恢复潜在归因的支持与方向，并用已知真值基准和 Amazon 数据检验该阈值与相容集。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「部分识别＋弃权」判据可能为 LVR 中视觉证据不足时的停止/弃权决策与 latent 归因可信度评估提供概念参考，但研究对象是用户偏好的代理测量，与 VLM 内部状态生成无直接联系，可供核查。
